name: Tui Engstrom-Fofana
role: High-risk package and data transport — courier
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Clark and Addison
description:
Tui Engstrom-Fofana is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in Meridian 88, the distinction is academic. At 56, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a courier out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Tui Engstrom-Fofana has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of Meridian 88
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Tui Engstrom-Fofana has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "I don't look inside the package. I don't ask about the package. I deliver the package."
"Speed is a skill. Knowing when to slow down is wisdom. I sell both."
"This route has three checkpoints and a kill zone. I'll be there in twenty minutes."

story_hooks: A dead drop Tui Engstrom-Fofana maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Someone is impersonating Tui Engstrom-Fofana on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Tui Engstrom-Fofana is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Tui Engstrom-Fofana functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster. Eye replacement — one organic, one cybernetic with recording capability and zoom
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
